channel.title: RealHunt: new homes
channel.description: New homes on RealHunt, checked by a person and scored from 70 to 98.

item.title: €82,000 · 2-bedroom house in good condition with fireplace and land in Le Vigeant, Vienne
item.description: Le Vigeant, Vienne. 83 m². RealHunt score 86. This house in good condition is habitable as is. It has 2 bedrooms, a separate fitted kitchen, a living room with a fireplace, a bathroom, a toilet and an attic bedroom. The property has a south-facing terrace, a garden side, 2,600 m² of land, a spring and a shed on adjoining land. Heating is electric, and the home is quiet and not overlooked, with 2 parking spaces. Asking €82,000, about €988/m².

item.title: €84,500 · Stone village house with land and countryside walks in Limoux, Aude
item.description: Limoux, Aude, Languedoc. 85 m². RealHunt score 82. Rustic stone village house in a quiet hamlet near Limoux, Aude. The ground floor has a kitchen/dining room, a large lounge at the rear and a shower room with WC, while upstairs there are two bedrooms and a second shower room with toilet. The house has 592 sq ft of land and a full sized attic that could be developed into a roof terrace, subject to the necessary permissions. Countryside walks start from the doorstep, and the house has electric heating. The town of Limoux is 15 minutes away. Asking €84,500, about €994/m².

item.title: €85,000 · Renovated 3-bedroom townhouse with cellar and clear views in Lacaune, Tarn
item.description: Lacaune, Tarn, Occitanie. 84 m². RealHunt score 84. This renovated townhouse is built over a cellar and set on two levels in a quiet street in Lacaune. The bright kitchen opens to a living room with a wood stove, and upstairs are three bedrooms and a bathroom with toilet. It has clear views but no land, and is joined to a neighbouring house on one side. Heating is by wood stove and electric radiant panels, with hot water from an electric cylinder. Shops, a nursery and a secondary school are nearby, Castres is 40 minutes away and Béziers 1 hour 40 minutes. Asking €85,000, about €1,012/m².

item.title: €81,700 · Move-in ready 3-bedroom stone house with garden and terrace in Chalvraines, Haute-Marne
item.description: Chalvraines, Haute-Marne. 82 m². RealHunt score 83. Move-in ready stone house in Chalvraines, in excellent condition and fully decorated. It has three bedrooms, two on the first floor and a third under the roofs that can be set up as an office or guest room, plus a living room with a fitted kitchen and a shower room with separate WC. Outside there is a recently fenced garden with a terrace, a vaulted cellar, a stone outbuilding and a parking space at the front. The house has a fireplace and wood heating. Asking €81,700, about €996/m².

item.title: €105,520 · Detached 4-bedroom house with garage, garden and land in Ménéac, Morbihan
item.description: Ménéac, Morbihan, Brittany. 101 m². RealHunt score 81. This detached house, built of concrete block with a slate roof, sits on the outskirts of the village of Ménéac. It has 101 m2 of living space across six rooms, including four bedrooms, an entrance hall, a utility room, a kitchen open to the dining and living room, a shower room and a toilet. A garage and a garden come with the home, and the 2,480 m2 plot includes a garden shed. Heating is provided by electric heating and aerothermal heating. Asking €105,520, about €1,045/m².

item.title: €125,100 · House with garden, orchard and garage in Saint-Christophe-en-Brionnais, Burgundy
item.description: Saint-Christophe-en-Brionnais, Burgundy. 118 m². RealHunt score 80. This house in a village in Brionnais has about 118 m2 of living space. Downstairs are a large fitted kitchen, a living room with a fireplace insert, a pantry, a bathroom and a separate WC. Upstairs are two large bedrooms, a small attic bedroom, an office and a shower room. Outside there is a garden with a well, an orchard with a tunnel, a workshop and a separate garage on 1713 m2 of land. Heating is gas central heating by tank. Asking €125,100, about €1,060/m².

item.title: €127,000 · Renovated 3-bedroom house with garden and garage in Les Gours, Charente
item.description: Les Gours, Charente. 126 m². RealHunt score 83. Renovated house with 3 bedrooms and 126 m2 of living space at the end of a cul-de-sac. Ground floor: kitchen area with wood-burning stove, 33 m2 double living room, renovated shower room and separate WC. First floor: 3 bedrooms, an annex bedroom and a shower room with WC. Enclosed tree-filled garden with garage, two outbuildings and 5,274 sq ft of land. Heating by wood and fuel, double glazing and insulation, with Aigre 10 minutes away and a lake less than 2 km away. Asking €127,000, about €1,008/m².

item.title: €89,500 · Stone house with terrace, garden and barn in Colondannes, Creuse
item.description: Colondannes, Creuse, Limousin. 82 m². RealHunt score 82. Stone house on the edge of Colondannes village, with 3 bedrooms and an 82 sq m living area. The layout includes a separate kitchen, a living/dining room with a fireplace, a shower room and a separate WC. Outdoors there is a terrace, a 450 sq m garden, a 2,500 sq m plot nearby and a detached 82 sq m barn. A garage area for one car is in the basement. Heating is oil-fired central with cast iron radiators. La Souterraine is 15 minutes away and Dun-le-Palestel is 5 minutes away. Asking €89,500, about €1,091/m².

item.title: €116,600 · Move-in ready 3-bedroom house with garden, garage and land in Fourmies, Nord
item.description: Fourmies, Nord. 113 m². RealHunt score 83. Move-in ready semi-detached house in Fourmies with neutral decor. The ground floor has a hallway, living room, kitchen with direct access to the rear courtyard, a shower room and a separate toilet. Upstairs are three bedrooms and a connecting room that can be used as an office, dressing room or storage. Features include a garden, a cellar, and an off-site plot about 20 metres away with a garage. Heating is by heat pump, with PVC double-glazed windows, and shops are close by in the town centre. Asking €116,600, about €1,032/m².

item.title: €113,000 · Renovated 4-bedroom house with balcony and land in Sainte-Foy-la-Grande, Gironde
item.description: Sainte-Foy-la-Grande, Gironde, Aquitaine. 109 m². RealHunt score 83. This renovated house stands in the heart of a bastide in Sainte-Foy-la-Grande, offering 109 m² of living space. The ground floor has an entrance hall, an equipped kitchen/dining room, a bright living room and a bathroom. Upstairs are two bedrooms, a dressing area and a shower room with WC, plus three second-floor rooms, two of them bedrooms. Features include a balcony and 635 sq ft of land, with gas-fired central heating connected to mains gas. Schools and local amenities are nearby. Asking €113,000, about €1,037/m².

item.title: €132,000 · Family house with garage, fireplace and 400 m² plot in Ambrières-les-Vallées, Mayenne
item.description: Ambrières-les-Vallées, Mayenne. 125 m². RealHunt score 79. This family house of about 125 m² has a finished basement room and a ground-floor bedroom. The finished room could serve as an office, a work-from-home area or a teenager's bedroom. Outside, a plot of about 400 m² offers space to relax, and a garage can also store pellets. The home has a fireplace and central heating powered by a pellet stove. It is a short walk from shops and schools. Asking €132,000, about €1,056/m².

item.title: €84,000 · Renovated 2-bedroom stone house with garden and terrace in L'Absie, Deux-Sèvres
item.description: L'Absie, Deux-Sèvres. 85 m². RealHunt score 83. Renovated stone house in a village, ready to move in. The ground floor has a bright living room with a pellet burner, a toilet, and a fitted kitchen. Upstairs are two parquet bedrooms and a shower room with WC. The south facing home has a front courtyard with a well, a rear garden, a terrace, and a workshop of about 20 m2 on 5,920 sq ft of land. Recent works include insulation, heating and rewiring, with Niort, Parthenay and Bressuire about 30 minutes away. Asking €84,000, about €988/m².

item.title: €145,000 · Well maintained townhouse with walled garden and workshop in Richelieu, Indre-et-Loire
item.description: Richelieu, Indre-et-Loire. 143 m². RealHunt score 83. This well maintained townhouse offers 143 m2 of living space a stone's throw from Richelieu town centre. Inside are an entrance hall, a living room with an open fireplace, a dining room, a fitted kitchen, a laundry/heating room, a WC and a storeroom. Upstairs, a landing serves four bedrooms, a bathroom and a separate WC. Outside, there is a small walled garden, a large workshop with an attic above, a covered double garage and a secure parking area. Collective central heating and double glazed joinery complete the home. Asking €145,000, about €1,014/m².

item.title: €104,500 · Well maintained townhouse with garden and garage in Arnac-la-Poste, Haute-Vienne
item.description: Arnac-la-Poste, Haute-Vienne. 98 m². RealHunt score 82. This well maintained townhouse in central Arnac-la-Poste offers 98 m2 of living space. Rooms include a living room, fitted kitchen, bright lounge, two bedrooms, a shower room with WC and a utility area. Outdoors there is a rear garden, a garage and 4,715 sq ft of land. Electric radiators provide heating. The A20 motorway is quick to reach, and La Souterraine is a few minutes away by car. Asking €104,500, about €1,066/m².

item.title: €116,600 · 3-bedroom house with garden, terrace and outbuildings in Saint-Denis-de-Jouhet, Indre
item.description: Saint-Denis-de-Jouhet, Indre. 105 m². RealHunt score 80. This 3-bedroom house sits in a green setting in Saint-Denis-de-Jouhet, Indre. It has 6 rooms, including a kitchen, a living room, a dining room with a fireplace and a small conservatory, plus a shower room and a separate toilet. Outside you will find an enclosed garden, a covered terrace, a garage and a parking space, plus a large tree-lined plot with a pond and several outbuildings including a converted barn. It has double glazing and electric heating. Asking €116,600, about €1,110/m².

item.title: €139,000 · Two-level 4-bedroom house with garden, terrace and garage in Gros-Chastang, Corrèze
item.description: Gros-Chastang, Corrèze. 130 m². RealHunt score 81. This 130 m² house arranged over two levels has four bedrooms and two bathrooms. The 36 m² living and dining room opens onto a terrace and a tree-lined garden of 1,200 m² at the rear, with no overlooking neighbours. The property also includes an attached garage, a utility room, a study and 11.5 m² of convertible attic space. The plot covers 12,917 sq ft of land in a quiet, pleasant setting. Asking €139,000, about €1,069/m².

item.title: €70,000 · Stone house in good condition with 2 bedrooms in Périgueux, Dordogne
item.description: Périgueux, Dordogne. 77 m². RealHunt score 83. This stone house in good condition is located in the centre of Périgueux. The ground floor has a main room with a kitchen and a toilet, the first floor has a landing, a bedroom and a shower room, and the second floor has a bedroom, a bathroom and an additional room. It has two bedrooms, a living area of 77 m² and no garden. It is suited to a first purchase or to investors wishing to create flats. Asking €70,000, about €909/m².

item.title: €120,750 · 2-bedroom townhouse with wood stove and land in Mortagne-sur-Gironde, Charente-Maritime
item.description: Mortagne-sur-Gironde, Charente-Maritime. 115 m². RealHunt score 79. This 115 m2 townhouse in the village of Mortagne-sur-Gironde has two bedrooms and a plot of 775 sq ft of land. The ground floor has a living, dining and kitchen room of 31 m2 with a wood stove, plus a separate toilet. Upstairs are a bedroom with a dressing room, a bathroom and a top-floor office with a shower room. Shops are within walking distance, and the village port and Gironde estuary are nearby. The home has PVC double glazing, sewer connection and redone electricity and insulation. Asking €120,750, about €1,050/m².

item.title: €129,600 · Fully renovated 3-bedroom house with terraces, garden and views in Merry-Sec, Burgundy
item.description: Merry-Sec, Burgundy. 124 m². RealHunt score 80. This fully renovated house spans two levels in a hamlet 20 km south of Auxerre. The ground floor has a large living room with a wood-burning stove, an open-plan kitchen, a shower room and a garage. Upstairs there are two bedrooms, a bathroom and a 44 m² room opening onto a second terrace. Outside there is a garden, a rear terrace and a large sloping plot with open views over the countryside. Heating comes from electric, aerothermal and reversible heat pumps, and Ouanne, with a school, is a few kilometres away. Asking €129,600, about €1,045/m².

item.title: €139,900 · Fully renovated 3-bedroom townhouse with garden in Villeneuve-sur-Lot, Lot-et-Garonne
item.description: Villeneuve-sur-Lot, Lot-et-Garonne. 139 m². RealHunt score 82. This fully renovated townhouse offers three bedrooms, an office, two shower rooms and a separate WC. The ground floor has a kitchen of about 20 m², a living room and a veranda opening directly outside, plus a utility room with cellar access. Outside there is a garden and 2,831 sq ft of land. Electrical and plumbing have been redone, the roof is in very good condition, and a city gas boiler provides heating. The house is connected to the mains sewer and has 139 m² of living area. Asking €139,900, about €1,006/m².

item.title: €127,000 · 3-bedroom stone house in good condition with garden and views in Aigre, Charente
item.description: Aigre, Charente. 126 m². RealHunt score 82. This 19th-century stone house is in good condition and has three bedrooms and two bathrooms. It includes an equipped separate kitchen and a garage with parking for three vehicles. The property has an enclosed garden and a lovely view of the fields and woods, plus 6,114 sq ft of land. It is heated by oil-fired central heating and has double glazing and excellent energy performance. A pharmacy, a grocery and bakery, and the Post Office are three kilometres away. Asking €127,000, about €1,008/m².

item.title: €134,000 · Spacious house with garden, terrace and garage in Villeneuve-sur-Lot, Lot-et-Garonne
item.description: Villeneuve-sur-Lot, Lot-et-Garonne. 128 m². RealHunt score 80. This 1960s house, built over a basement, has five bedrooms and 128 m2 of living space. Upstairs, an entrance hall leads to an open-plan living area of about 40 m2 with kitchen, living room and dining room, plus three bedrooms, a bathroom and a separate toilet. The basement holds a 34 m2 garage, a 23 m2 laundry room, two further bedrooms, an office and a second toilet. A fenced, landscaped garden of about 415 m2 has a terrace, and there is one parking space. Collective central heating is installed. Asking €134,000, about €1,047/m².

item.title: €94,000 · Move-in ready terraced house with garden and terrace in Boubers-sur-Canche, Pas-de-Calais
item.description: Boubers-sur-Canche, Pas-de-Calais. 86 m². RealHunt score 82. This move-in ready terraced house is in good general condition and ready to move into. It has two bedrooms, an office, a 21 sq m living room, an 18 sq m dining room and an 11 sq m fitted kitchen. Outdoor features include a garden, a wooden terrace, a cellar and 2,142 sq ft of land. Oil-fired central heating, double glazing with shutters and mains drainage complete the property. The living room has a chimney flue. Asking €94,000, about €1,093/m².

item.title: €123,650 · 3-bedroom house with garden and swimming pool in Asnois, Vienne
item.description: Asnois, Vienne. 112 m². RealHunt score 81. This three-bedroom house stands in a small hamlet, with a large open-plan living area and a corner kitchen. All three bedrooms are on the first floor, and the ground floor living area has a wood-burning stove and exposed beams. Outside, there is a courtyard at the front, a garden with a swimming pool and terrace, a shed and a barn, on a plot of 30,247 sq ft of land. A village 3 km away has a school, post office, bar/restaurant and bakery. Asking €123,650, about €1,104/m².

item.title: €150,000 · Town centre 3-bedroom house with garage and commercial premises in Auch, Gers
item.description: Auch, Gers. 136 m². RealHunt score 77. This house in the heart of Auch has living accommodation and commercial premises on the ground floor. It offers 136 m2 of living space, 8 rooms, 3 bedrooms and 1 bathroom. The house includes a 25 m2 garage and a cellar, and it has gas-fired central heating. The ground-floor premises are easily accessible and can suit various types of business, or a home with rental potential. Asking €150,000, about €1,103/m².

item.title: €149,950 · Four-bedroom house with pool and garden in Ruffec, Charente
item.description: Ruffec, Charente. 152 m². RealHunt score 83. This 1970s pavilion house has four bedrooms, and the basement bedroom has its own dressing room, bathroom and furnished living area. The 34 m² living room has parquet flooring, three patio doors and a fireplace, and the home also has a shower room and a separate kitchen. Outside there is a garden, a terrace, an 8 m x 4 m pool, views, 70,062 sq ft of land and a garage. It has oil-fired central heating and double-glazed windows. The hamlet is 10 km from Ruffec and 6 km from Verteuil-sur-Charente. Asking €149,950, about €987/m².

item.title: €105,000 · House with garden, terrace and walled plot in Devay, Burgundy
item.description: Devay, Burgundy. 105 m². RealHunt score 81. This house is raised on a basement in a calm, pleasant setting in Devay. The ground floor has an entrance, a fitted kitchen, a dining room, three bedrooms and a bathroom with toilet. The basement adds a kitchen and laundry room, a study, a bedroom and a garage. Outside, there is a 70 m2 terrace with no overlooking and a walled, tree-covered plot of over 1800 m2 with a garden. Comfort comes from individual oil heating installed in 2013, air conditioning and double-glazed windows. Asking €105,000, about €1,000/m².

item.title: €148,400 · Renovated 2-bedroom stone house with garden and swimming pool in Arques, Aude, Languedoc
item.description: Arques, Aude, Languedoc. 137 m². RealHunt score 81. Renovated stone house in the heart of a village, formerly a village café, with 137.96 m2 of living space. It has 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, with a 41.12 m2 living room opening onto a 195 m2 garden, a fitted kitchen opening onto a 17 m2 terrace, and a second-floor room with a 5.72 m2 terrace. The property includes an above-ground swimming pool and 3,122 sq ft of land. The village is in the Corbières vertes, with numerous hiking trails and multiple natural sites. Asking €148,400, about €1,083/m².

item.title: €110,000 · Renovated 4-bedroom house with garden, terrace and outbuildings in Haut-Bocage, Allier
item.description: Haut-Bocage, Allier. 105 m². RealHunt score 83. This renovated house has a single-storey living room with a fireplace, a fitted kitchen and one bedroom. The first floor holds three more bedrooms, a shower room and separate toilets, giving 105 m2 of living space and 5 rooms. Outdoor features include a fenced garden, a terrace, outbuildings and garage access via the patio. The property also includes 5,920 sq ft of land. Asking €110,000, about €1,048/m².

item.title: €97,000 · Well maintained 4-bedroom house with garden and covered terrace in Pineuilh, Gironde
item.description: Pineuilh, Gironde. 94 m². RealHunt score 83. This well maintained house has four bedrooms spread over two floors. The ground floor has a living room, a kitchen, a brand-new shower room and a separate WC, with a conservatory adjoining the kitchen. Outside you will find a garden of about 230 m2, a covered terrace and space to park one vehicle. The home has gas-fired central heating, with the boiler replaced one year ago, and new mechanical ventilation. Asking €97,000, about €1,032/m².

item.title: €110,000 · 2-bedroom farmhouse with garage, cellar and outbuilding in Chailley, Yonne, Burgundy
item.description: Chailley, Yonne, Burgundy. 110 m². RealHunt score 80. This 110 m² farmhouse sits in Le Vaudevanne, a hamlet of Chailley. The ground floor has a living room, a dining room with a fitted kitchen, a bedroom and a shower room with a toilet, while upstairs there is a large bedroom, a second shower room, a toilet and an attic that could be converted into an extra bedroom. It includes a garage, a cellar, an outbuilding with a bread oven, two shelters and 884 m² of enclosed, tree-lined land. Electric heating is installed. Asking €110,000, about €1,000/m².

item.title: €139,000 · Two-house property with 3 bedrooms and land in Meixedo e Padornelos, Trás-os-Montes
item.description: Meixedo e Padornelos, Trás-os-Montes. 110 m². RealHunt score 81. The property comprises two separate houses on one plot: a 2-bedroom house and a 1-bedroom house. The 2-bedroom house has a living and dining room, a kitchen, two bedrooms and a full bathroom. The 1-bedroom house has an open-plan kitchen, one bedroom, a full bathroom and a laundry room. The 2,153 sq ft plot suits one family living in one house while renting the other, two families, or investment. It is 400 metres from the health centre, pharmacies and shops. Asking €139,000, about €1,264/m².

item.title: €129,000 · Fully renovated 1-bedroom stone house with garden and mountain views in Skripero, Corfu
item.description: Skripero, Corfu. 80 m². RealHunt score 85. This fully renovated detached house was rebuilt from a traditional stone house in 2025. It has one main bedroom with a fireplace, a guest or children's room, an open-plan kitchen, living and dining area, and two bathrooms with walk-in showers. Outdoor features include a large rear garden with lawn, a paved front courtyard with covered BBQ area, a 634.11 sq m plot and open mountain views. It has air conditioning, double glazing and a new roof. The airport is 18 km away and Corfu Town is 17 km away. Asking €129,000, about €1,612/m².

item.title: €95,850 · Stone house in good condition with terrace and garage in Saint-Fraimbault, Orne, Normandy
item.description: Saint-Fraimbault, Orne, Normandy. 91 m². RealHunt score 82. This stone house with a slate roof is in good condition and has 91 m2 of living space. It has a separate kitchen, a ground floor shower room and two very large double bedrooms with parquet floors on the first floor. Outdoor features include a south facing terrace, 4,650 sq ft of land, an outbuilding with an attic, 2 garages and 5 parking spaces. The lounge has a fireplace with a wood burning stove, and the home has electric heating. Passais is 2.5 miles away and Ambrières les Vallées is a 10 minute drive. Asking €95,850, about €1,053/m².

item.title: €125,080 · 3-bedroom house with garden and wood stove in Guémené-sur-Scorff, Morbihan
item.description: Guémené-sur-Scorff, Morbihan. 116 m². RealHunt score 78. This house in the centre of Guémené-sur-Scorff has 3 bedrooms and 116 m2 of living space. The ground floor offers an entrance hall, a fitted kitchen, a living room and a dining room with a wood-burning stove. Upstairs there are two bedrooms and a large bathroom, and the second floor holds a master suite with an en-suite shower room. It has a small garden, 1,087 sq ft of land and wood heating. Asking €125,080, about €1,078/m².

item.title: €145,000 · In good condition 1-bedroom country house with pool and garden in Fortuna, Murcia
item.description: Fortuna, Murcia. 150 m². RealHunt score 87. This house is in good condition, built in 2000 on one floor. It has a bright dining room, an independent kitchen, one bedroom and a full bathroom. Outdoors there is a large garden plot, a sunny terrace, a balcony, a private pool and a garage with storage. Reversible air conditioning and a fireplace provide comfort in all seasons, and a septic tank manages wastewater. It sits in a rural location in Fortuna, Murcia. Asking €145,000, about €967/m².

item.title: €108,900 · Move-in ready 3-bedroom cottage with garden and countryside views in Tilly, Indre
item.description: Tilly, Indre. 106 m². RealHunt score 83. This move-in ready cottage sits in a peaceful hamlet with modern, spacious living. It has three bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, a large living room and a family dining room. Outside there is a lovely garden with countryside views, parking, and an outbuilding with a garage. Heating comes from electric heating and wood-burning stoves. Chaillac is 6 km away and Limoges International Airport is less than an hour away. Asking €108,900, about €1,027/m².

item.title: €126,500 · 4-bedroom house with terrace and wooded land in Chassenon, Charente
item.description: Chassenon, Charente. 124 m². RealHunt score 82. This four-bedroom house in Chassenon, Charente offers 124 m2 of living space across six rooms. It has a 29 m2 living room with a wood-burning insert, an 11 m2 kitchen and a bathroom with a bathtub and shower. Outside there is a covered terrace, a wooded plot of 3,681 sq ft, and two garages with four parking spaces. A full basement can be used as a cellar, storage space or workshop. Heating comes from a fuel boiler with hot-water radiators in every room. Asking €126,500, about €1,020/m².

item.title: €97,500 · Village house with four bedrooms and games room in Olonzac, Hérault
item.description: Olonzac, Hérault, Languedoc. 95 m². RealHunt score 82. This village house in Olonzac offers about 95 square metres of living space. It has four bedrooms, a kitchen, a living and dining room, an office, a games room and two shower rooms. The agent describes a layout suited to a family, a second-home project or tourist accommodation. Electric heating is listed among its features. Nearby are the Canal du Midi, Lake Jouarres, the Minervois vineyards and the historic village of Minerve, with Carcassonne and Narbonne also close by. Asking €97,500, about €1,026/m².

item.title: €122,000 · Renovated 3-bedroom farmhouse with garden and fireplace in Adriers, Vienne
item.description: Adriers, Vienne. 115 m². RealHunt score 83. This renovated farmhouse stands in a quiet hamlet close to Adriers. It offers three bedrooms, including a large downstairs bedroom with a modern shower room, plus a separate WC and a large kitchen, lounge and dining room with a larder. The 12,648 sq ft plot includes a fenced garden with a gated entrance and a shed for storage, plus a fireplace and a cellar. The house has new heat pump heating. Amenities are close by in Adriers, with Bussière-Poitevine, Bellac and Lussac nearby. Asking €122,000, about €1,061/m².
